title: on_enter goto skips the destination room's on_enter effects
body:
A goto inside a room's on_enter moves the player, but the destination's on_enter (and its entry-time win check) does not fire for that hop: core/engine.ts:117-122 runs the hook once, non-recursively. The post-step checkWin (:128-132) still catches wins, so wins are safe — but an authored teleport-on-enter room silently skips the destination's entry effects, and no validator flags the pattern.

Either make on_enter fire for the final room after a hook-driven move (bounded, to keep MAX_ENGINE_STEP semantics; watch for authored goto cycles), or add a foundation-validator finding for on_enter goto so authors learn the rule at validate time. Shipped packs currently avoid the pattern, so this is a future-authoring hazard, not a live defect.

From the 2026-08-30 full audit, findings ledger P3 (engine section).
